---
title: "About"
---

This is a public working notebook for Leif Denby's role as UWC ML Liaison.

The role focuses on helping UWC institutions and related communities understand
and coordinate work on machine-learning weather prediction (MLWP), especially
where shared scientific understanding, verification, data formats, and tooling
can reduce duplication and improve operational readiness.

## What This Site Is

- A role-branded blog and project hub.
- A place to share synthesis, open questions, and collaboration opportunities.
- A public complement to private internal tracking and project notes.

## What This Site Is Not

- An official E-AI website.
- A formal UWC governance channel.
- A complete documentation portal for MLWP tools.
- A public archive of private meeting notes or institutional positions.

## How To Engage

Suggestions for papers, seminar topics, datasets, verification methods,
collaboration opportunities, or project links are welcome. See [Contact](contact.qmd).
